desc: Ideation and selection of approach (switch from value-block lazy sweep to index-block decomposition).
Choose and tune block size dynamically (roughly sqrt(2*N*N/K), clamped to keep memory/time reasonable).
Precompute sorted values and prefix sums for every block of A and B.
Build `prefA`: for each A block, rows are local prefixes in original order, columns are prefixes of full B blocks.
Build `prefB` symmetrically for B local prefixes against full A blocks.
Build `block_sum` from final rows of `prefA`, then build its 2D prefix table for full-block/full-block queries.
Implement query answering: full-full via 2D prefix, partial-full via `prefA`/`prefB`, partial-partial via sorting the smaller prefix and binary-searching prefix sums.
Test on samples and edge cases (N=1, block boundaries, all equal values, X/Y at multiples of block size).
If time/memory is still problematic, tune block size or consider the value-block lazy sweep as a fallback.
